input.summary: Add express New York governing law and exclusive New York County court venue.
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no governing law or venue provision, and §27 leaves disputes to the Management Committee (which may impose arbitration) as the sole remedy. We have added our standard position: New York law with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County; Delaware, California or England and Wales with the courts of London would also work for us.

ops.text: 27.3 This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York, and the Parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York in respect of any dispute arising under or in connection with this Agreement.
